Record your trips, rides, outdoor activities, and everyday scenes in up to 4K/24FPS.
SJ6 Legend also supports 2K at 30 FPS and Full HD recording at up to 60 FPS, giving
you different options depending on how you want to shoot.
2.0″ Rear Touchscreen
Touch, Check, Adjust
Use the 2.0-inch touchscreen to navigate camera settings, adjust shooting options,
and review your footage directly on the camera. The touch interface keeps common
controls within reach without relying on a phone.
Take the Camera Below the Surface
Add the waterproof housing when your shooting takes you into the water. The SJ6 Legend
can be used down to 30 meters with the case, making it suitable for swimming, snorkeling,
diving, and other underwater activities.
Three Axes for a Steadier View
Handheld shooting rarely stays perfectly still. The SJ6 Legend uses a 3-axis gyroscope
stabilization to help reduce unwanted camera movement and produce a steadier
view while you’re walking, riding, or recording handheld footage.
Off
On
Control Your Camera From Your Phone
With the SJCAM Zone app, your phone becomes a convenient remote interface for
SJ6 Legend. Connect wirelessly to check the live view, adjust camera settings, start or
stop recording, and review your footage without having to reach for the camera.
Remote Control Support
Use the compatible wrist remote to operate key camera functions from a distance.
The remote is sold separately.
Time-lapse
Condense gradual changes into a shorter sequence. Use time-lapse to record moving clouds, changing landscapes, busy streets, or other scenes where the passage of time is part of the story.
Slow Motion
Record fast-moving scenes at a higher frame rate and slow them down during playback to reveal movement that happens too quickly to notice at normal speed.
Bring a Spare for Longer Days
The SJ6 Legend uses a removable 1000mAh battery, giving you the option to carry an
additional battery for longer shooting sessions. Battery life is rated at approximately
80 minutes with Wi-Fi on and up to 110 minutes with Wi-Fi off.
Build the Setup Around the Activity
SJ6 Legend works with a range of compatible accessories, including mounts, selfie sticks,
floats, and headbands. Choose the setup that matches how and where you plan to record.
